name: @verified-attention/sdk
description: Verified Attention SDK monorepo (browser, mobile, desktop, extension)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @verified-attention/browser-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @verified-attention/mobile-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @verified-attention/desktop-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @verified-attention/extension-sdk run build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @verified-attention/browser-sdk run dev & pnpm --filter @verified-attention/mobile-sdk run dev & pnpm --filter @verified-attention/desktop-sdk run dev & pnpm --filter @verified-attention/extension-sdk run dev
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @verified-attention/browser-sdk run test && pnpm --filter @verified-attention/mobile-sdk run test && pnpm --filter @verified-attention/desktop-sdk run test && pnpm --filter @verified-attention/extension-sdk run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @verified-attention/browser-sdk run typecheck && pnpm --filter @verified-attention/mobile-sdk run typecheck && pnpm --filter @verified-attention/desktop-sdk run typecheck && pnpm --filter @verified-attention/extension-sdk run typecheck
